Fine Trade — Delete Account

Request deletion of your Fine Trade account and associated data

Fine Trade (Android app) lets you manage protector stock and optional Google Drive backup. Use this page to request that your account and related data are deleted.

How to request account deletion

  1. Send an email to muhammadumersheraz2000@gmail.com
  2. Use the subject line: Delete Fine Trade account
  3. Include the email address used to sign in to Fine Trade (Google or email/password)
  4. Optionally write: “Please delete my Fine Trade account and associated data.”

We will verify ownership of the account and process your request.

What data is deleted

  • Your Fine Trade Firebase Authentication account (email, display name, auth identifiers)
  • Your Fine Trade Google Drive backup folder/files created under our operator Drive (Fine Trade / your email), when a backup exists

What data may be kept

  • Data on your phone (local stock JSON) remains until you clear Fine Trade app data or uninstall the app
  • Short-lived technical logs (e.g. HTTPS timestamps) may be retained briefly for security, then removed in normal log rotation

Retention period

We aim to complete account and cloud backup deletion within 30 days of a verified request. You will receive a confirmation email when deletion is finished.

Delete some data without deleting your account

Inside the Fine Trade app you can delete individual protectors (and their linked models on that record) at any time. That does not delete your login account.

Contact

Questions: muhammadumersheraz2000@gmail.com
